title: Ben Kreuter   RWC 2017
summary: A Real World Crypto 2017 talk by a Google engineer on using private set intersection to match ad views with in-store purchases. It describes privacy-preserving matching that avoids exposing personal transactions.
why: Cited in threads about Google's purchase tracking as the technical source for how the matching might work.

quote.text: According to what they presented at a crypto conference, they went to great pains to avoid capturing personally identifiable transactions.
